caption: About 3.5 minutes after install the Cartly drawer opened in the theme editor preview, with a You might also like upsell under the cart.
Pressing Add on the upsell put the snowboard in the cart: 5 items became 6 and the checkout total went up.
The drawer only shows once Cart status is switched on in the app; our first look had it off.
Growth at $16.99 every 30 days plus usage fees showed as a test charge that is not billed on our development store.
The app's pricing table: usage fees rise with monthly orders, and all plans are free for development stores.
